messages:
marco: noticed vault audit sink for namespace 'partners' stopped at ~11:22 UTC after an RBAC prune. small gap ~11:22-11:35. anyone else tracking?

anya: yep i removed a legacy repo writer binding at 11:20 to lock down access. might be related.

felix: which SA writes the audit sink? infra-bot, show last write event.

infra-bot: last sink write: 2026-04-04T11:21:45Z by serviceAccount:svc-audit-writer@redwood-project. Role repo-writer removed from svc-ci at 11:19:58Z.

marco: plan: restore access long enough to rehydrate from kms-wrapped backups, scan plaintext for exposed creds, rotate anything found, then revoke perms. prefer short-lived grant.

anya: i can grant cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to serviceAccount:kms-importer@infra for 7m. will log change and revert.

infra-bot: Permission change applied: kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter granted to serviceAccount:kms-importer@infra. Requestor: anya.

felix: running decrypt+import dry-run. vault-bot, please flag any lines matching "VAULT_TOKEN|ACCESS_KEY|client_secret".

vault-bot: dry-run complete: 64 events available, 1 truncated blob (11:27) flagged, 1 match found: partial VAULT_TOKEN in 11-26.json.

marco: rotate exposed token now, update k8s secret, restart consumer. I'll handle revocation and incident doc.

anya: revoking kms grant and filing follow-ups: add automated alert for sink write failures and require owner ack on RBAC sweeps.

infra-bot: Permission change reverted: kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter removed from serviceAccount:kms-importer@infra.

marco: incident INC-2026-131 created, owners assigned (marco, anya, felix). closing after import complete and rotation verified.
